KP - SUP - KP offers SUP adventures for those who want to see the Dniester from a different perspective. We create ready-made routes of varying difficulty, organize transfers from Kamianets-Podilskyi, provide equipment, and support participants throughout the entire trip.
Our format is small groups of up to 4 people, making every adventure comfortable, safe, and full of atmosphere.
We constantly explore new sections of the Dniester and add tested routes. Each route has its own length, duration, difficulty, and price.
